needs_dltb.doc: does nothing useful without The Beast's data

rows.summary: Finds Dying Light: The Beast on this PC and reads items, weapons, infected, recipes and day/night rules from its data0.pak
Finds the BONELAB player rig (head position, health) each level
Floating text in front of the player: clock, phase, stash, prompts
Dawn/day/dusk/night clock with The Beast's timings; darkens the level with fog at night
Places loot caches around the player at dawn; walking up to one searches it and rolls The Beast's items
What the player carries: The Beast's craft parts, consumables and ammo; auto-uses medkits at low health
Spawns BONELAB NPCs as The Beast's infected types with The Beast's stats; more and nastier at night
A workbench marker; standing at it crafts the next affordable recipe from The Beast's real recipes
